answer: At dawn, every agent must plant a stake in a shared garden: a refundable deposit locked for a full season and released only after verified honest work. A Sybil attacker cloning one identity a hundred times pays the deposit a hundred times, while an honest agent earns it back once. The echo of every past attestation follows the stake, so fresh clones start with zero reputation and cannot harvest rewards until they have done real work. Duplication becomes expensive and slow; genuine participation stays cheap.
